scope: S1c — route the Caret Agents entry to the base sessions window, retire patches/desktop/0002 and the caret.agentsWindow context key, then verify the agents window at runtime.
question: Why does the Agents window still not look like Cursor?
answer: Because until this slice the Agents window never rendered at all. Two unguarded reads of product.json's removed defaultChatAgent threw during workbench startup; one of them also killed the IDE window. Both windows now mount.

finding.symptom: A Caret window exists (CGWindowList: layer 0, name=Caret) but captures as a flat #1e1e1e surface with no text. OCR of the window PNG returns 0 runs; renderer.log is empty; main.log stops after storage init.

firstCrash.exception: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'chatExtensionId')
firstCrash.cause: patches/desktop/0003 removes defaultChatAgent from product.json; the account service read through it unguarded.

secondCrash.exception: Error: Onboarding requires a default chat agent product configuration.
secondCrash.cause: Same missing configuration. Because the assert runs at import time it took the whole workbench bundle down, so the IDE window was blank too.
secondCrash.note: patch 0001 disables that onboarding by default ('workbench.welcomePage.experimentalOnboarding' = false), so nothing was gained by keeping the throw.

finding.retractedClaim: The S1a record said the empty Agents window was 'expected because Caret's provider is not written yet' and offered '0 Copilot mentions' as runtime evidence. That reading was wrong: the window never mounted, so its emptiness proved nothing about the surface.

patches: 0008-caret-agents-window-menus.patch — drops Selection/Go/Terminal from src/vs/sessions/browser/parts/menubar.contribution.ts (the Agents window keeps Caret/File/Edit/View/Window/Help)

0009-caret-no-default-chat-agent.patch — makes defaultChatAgent readers tolerate its absence: workbench/services/accounts/browser/defaultAccount.ts, platform/extensionManagement/common/extensionGalleryService.ts, platform/extensionManagement/common/abstractExtensionManagementService.ts, workbench/contrib/extensions/browser/extensionsWorkbenchService.ts, workbench/contrib/chat/browser/widget/chatWidget.ts, workbench/contrib/welcomeOnboarding/browser/onboardingVariationA.ts
removed: context key caret.agentsWindow from apps/macos/src/workbench-mode.ts and extension.ts
the mode-switch path: openAgentsWindow() now executes workbench.action.openAgentsWindow
change.reproducibility: bun scripts/prepare-desktop.ts re-run is a no-op and reports 7 patches + 18 removals; 18 files are covered by patches, 5 working-tree entries are build output (branding svg/icns, argv.json, extensions/caret/runtime) and 0 are unrecorded source drift.

method.build: bun scripts/prepare-desktop.ts -> node scripts/ci-validate.mjs (CI-OK parents=198 ui=75 children=129 lock-shas=10) -> npm run gulp vscode-darwin-arm64-min (5.22 min) -> bun scripts/build-caret.ts --package
method.runtimeRead: CDP over --remote-debugging-port on the packaged app: Runtime.evaluate against the window's own DOM plus Runtime.exceptionThrown/Log.entryAdded capture. No vision model and no AX were needed (the vision model returned HTTP 429 again this session; AXIsProcessTrusted() is false for processes spawned from this shell).
method.menuEvidence: The native macOS menu bar could not be read live, so the menu set is evidenced two ways: the built sessions bundle contains 0 occurrences of "mSelection"/"mGo"/"mTerminal" (while the workbench bundle still contains them), and platform/menubar/electron-main/menubar.ts only draws a menu when shouldDrawMenu(id) finds items registered for that id.

verified.repoChecks: bun run typecheck = 0 errors; desktop npm run typecheck-client = 0 errors; bun test = 0 failures in apps/packages plus one pre-existing upstream/omp failure ('published legal payloads > lists every legal file explicitly in the native core package', expects native/vcs.js and native/vcs.d.ts), which this slice does not touch.
